intro: Brandur Ironhammer is a dwarven paladin trainer residing in the Hall of Mysteries within Ironforge. He guides aspiring champions of the Holy Light through their early rites, testing their devotion and dispatching them across the Alliance.

sections.t: A Guide in the Mystic Ward
p: Stationed within the quiet alcoves of the Hall of Mysteries, Brandur Ironhammer serves the Alliance by instructing novice paladins in the ways of the Holy Light. Alongside his peer, Tiza Battleforge, Brandur keeps a watchful eye on young dwarven champions, guiding them through the trials of the Tome of Divinity. While deeply committed to his holy duties, he has acknowledged personal flaws under Tiza's frank counsel, working diligently to temper his envy and maintain the inner purity demanded of a warrior of the Light.

Brandur serves as an essential liaison between Ironforge and the wider Alliance brotherhood. When human initiates find their way into the dwarven mountain, he redirects them back south to Duthorian Rall in the Cathedral of Light. As paladins grow seasoned in the field, Brandur coordinates their deployment to battlegrounds such as Chillwind Camp in the Western Plaguelands, eventually sending veteran crusaders to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker to undertake the demanding trials of the war charger.
